scope: Read-only CI structure proposal based on actual4h44m Happy and63m local Error, within existing6h job ceiling; no owner workflow edit yet
proposed: Two fixed segment jobs (matrix fail-fast false), each retains existing pinned container/resources/SDK/tool source/config/full predicate/threshold and360minute bound; native verify its own complete report and upload allowed report/provenance artifacts only.

Aggregate job keeps original source-tools-mutation required-check identity; check out exact same source/container/environment, independently prepare the identical authenticated job-private tool, download both same-run segment artifacts and run unchanged strict BOTH validator with RequireCompatibilityProvenance.

Aggregate additionally requires both segment job results success, preserves failed reports and uploads the original aggregate artifact name. Lifecycle job and workflow triggers/concurrency/protections remain intact.

Independent tool rebuild/digest equality was empirically proved at one local clean path; actual aggregate strict equality must still pass on real hosted jobs; never rewrite receipts or forge GitHub context.
reason: Avoid serial complete cohorts competing for one hosted6h lifetime; parallel execution preserves each complete technical gate without distributing the private runtime.
